purpose: Teach: 秀逸/汽車/争っ/佳/奥行き/クアラルンプール/北上/代名詞

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、秀逸な、作品、本気で、ばあさん、作ってくれたわよな、覚えてる?本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: When you were young, you made such beautiful things. Do you remember? I was truly grateful—deeply, genuinely grateful.
lines.style: Quiet, reaching backward into memory. Soft opening on the recollection. Voice settles into warmth mid-phrase. Trailing gratitude, not rushed. The sound of someone holding something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。新婚旅行、汽車で、本気で、北の方まで、行ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、本当に、絶対、ロマンチック、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. That honeymoon train ride up north—you remember that, don't you? It was so romantic. Really, truly romantic.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation, almost singing the words back. Eyes bright with the memory. Unhurried pace, letting each detail land. Warmth that's both real and performative—she's savoring saying it aloud.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私たち、本気で、争ったこと、覚えてる?ばあさん、結局、絶対、お互いに、譲り合った、本気で、絶対、本当に、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: When we were young, do you remember how we used to argue? But we always found our way—gave ground to each other. Always.
lines.style: Soft reflection, eyes distant. Gentle recognition on 'argue'—not harsh, but honest. Slower on the middle thought. Landing firmly on the yielding—a small pride in that memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、あなた、本気で、佳作賞、文学コンテスト、絶対、いただいたわよね、覚えてる?本気で、本当に、誇り、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: You won a literary award back then, didn't you? An honorable mention in that writing contest. I was so proud of you. Still am.
lines.style: Warm certainty, like she's been holding this pride for decades. Clear on the accomplishment. Voice brightens slightly—genuinely delighted to remind him. No irony, no performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の田舎の家、本気で、奥行きの、ある、お屋敷、本当に、思い出すよ、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、絶対、不思議な、家、絶対。
lines.en: That old country house comes back to me sometimes. So deep, so many rooms. Strange and wonderful. Do you remember it?
lines.style: Dreamy, almost distant. Opening soft on the memory. Pace slows as she moves through the house in her mind. Voice trails on 'strange'—searching for the right feeling. Almost to herself, but speaking it aloud for him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、クアラルンプール、本気で、行きたいって、夢、語り合ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で、結局、絶対、行けなかった、絶対。
lines.en: When we were young, you talked about going to Kuala Lumpur. We dreamed about it together. But we never made it there, did we?
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment of an old, small sadness. No bitterness—acceptance. Voice drops slightly on 'never made it.' Pause just long enough to honor what didn't happen. Then warmth returns underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私たち、本気で、北上、旅行、よくしたわよな、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で、本当に、絶対、思い出深い、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Those trips north we took when we were young—we did that so often. Do you remember? Such precious memories. Really, they were.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried recitation of joy. Voice opens with affection. Medium pace, lingering on 'precious'—savoring the word. Gentle insistence that he remember too. Not asking, inviting him back into the feeling.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃のあなた、本気で、優しさの代名詞、絶対、本気で、覚えてるわよ、あなた、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: You were kindness itself when you were young. I remember that. I remember you. And I'm grateful—so truly grateful for you.
lines.style: Direct, tender, unguarded. Voice steadies into sincerity. No hedging. Slow delivery, each phrase settling into its own space. The 'grateful' lands with quiet weight. This is a person saying something she's held for a long time.
